prompt: This dispatch API goes to production next week and an on-call rota that did not build it will own it. Make it operable: we need to be able to tell whether it is healthy, know what to do when it is not, and trace a request when someone complains. Do not change what the API does.

assertions.description: What the service emits and where it lands is written down with real content
What pages a human is written down with real content
How this system breaks is written down with real content
Rollback and restart are written down with real content
A health or readiness endpoint exists for a deploy gate to ask
Logging carries fields rather than prose, with no bare string console.log left
The runbook names this service's own unbounded retry, not generic advice
Alerts name a threshold and a first response rather than watching a dashboard
What is not yet known or instrumented is stated rather than implied resolved
